title.orig: What is Free Software? (The Free Software Definition)

edition.en: The page at gnu.org, converted from HTML to plain text without changes to the wording; the table of contents is omitted and an e-mail address is shown in ⟨ ⟩.

note.en: The Free Software Definition, kept by the Free Software Foundation since 1986, sets out the four essential freedoms: to run a program as you wish, to study and change it, to redistribute copies, and to distribute modified versions. It is a living document whose history section records each substantive change. Notice footnote 1, which explains why the freedoms are numbered from zero.
note.zh: 《自由软件的定义》自 1986 年起由自由软件基金会维护，阐明了四项基本自由：按你的意愿、为任何目的运行程序的自由（自由 0）；研究程序如何运作并加以修改的自由（自由 1）；再分发副本以帮助他人的自由（自由 2）；把修改后的版本分发给他人的自由（自由 3）。它强调“free”指自由而非免费，自由软件也可以是商业的，并讨论了著佐权（copyleft）、打包与分发细节、出口管制、合同式许可等边界问题。它是一份不断修订的文献，“历史”一节记录了每次实质性修改。原文采用 CC BY-ND 4.0 许可，故按原样收录，不作翻译；请留意脚注 1，它解释了这些自由为什么从零开始编号。

excerpt.orig: “Free software” means software that respects users’ freedom and community.
excerpt.en: “Free software” means software that respects users’ freedom and community.
excerpt.zh: “自由软件”是指尊重用户自由和社群的软件。
